notes.title: The Basics!
notes.content:
This update is the first step for both me and Cubic Chess, as it marks the first beta update that is fully playable as a user and ready to enjoy!

[h2]This update includes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Local and Online Multiplayer
[*] Simplified UI
[*] Check, Checkmate, Draw end States
[*] Turn counter
[*] Sensitivity Setting
[/list]

Any feedback or suggestions are appreciated, as well as any initial bugs discovered can help me create an overall amazing experience!

Sincerely,
The single person making this.
